title: Thou art Peter.
html_source:
Matthew 16:18

You are Peter—“Thou art peter”

anchor.prefix: offey. I knew his name was like a coffin. Domine-namine. Bully about the muzzle he looks. Bosses the show. Muscular christian. Woe betide anyone that looks crooked at him: priest.
anchor.suffix:
